summary: Bressanone (Brixen) runs its paid parking itself: the municipality manages four barrier-controlled car parks (Parkhaus Brixen in Dantestrasse, Priel, the Rosslauf underground car park and the Mobility Centre) and eight metered lots. The Dantestrasse garage, built in 1993 and run for more than 30 years by a private concessionaire, passed to the municipality at the end of January 2025; in a court settlement on 27 February 2026 the former operator agreed to bear the cost of structural securing for ten years. The city executive raised tariffs at the garage, Priel and the Mobility Centre from 1 January 2026 and at the Rosslauf underground car park from 5 December 2025, and announced on 24 June 2026 that tariffs at metered lots would be adjusted to inflation from 1 July 2026, with a one-hour limit at most of them, partly to draw drivers towards the cheaper barrier car parks and the garage. On 9 September 2026 the municipality announced that the garage's ticketing system would be integrated into the system of Priel, Rosslauf and the Mobility Centre on 16 and 17 September 2026; completion was not confirmed by any source read. The mobility plan (PUMS, approved by the council on 10 February 2022) aims at fewer cars in the old town, and in August 2026 the provincial government approved changed technical features of the Suedspange bypass, with 12 million EUR for the municipal section. No live availability display, official utilisation statistics, Christmas-market traffic plan or Stadtwerke-run charging data were found; the only utilisation remark is a qualitative note of high utilisation at southern Priel.

items.text: The council approved Bressanone's sustainable urban mobility plan (PUMS) by resolution no. 8 of 10 February 2022, after the city executive had adopted the draft on 25 August 2021. The plan says about 50% of vehicle traffic entering the city is bound for the old town, and its core measures include a 30 km/h city, more people and fewer cars in the centre (parking, limited-traffic zone, bike parking) and a pedestrian-friendly old town.
items.source_title: Mobilitaetsplan - PUMS Entwicklung und Ergebnis - Gemeinde Brixen

items.text: The council approved the ordinance on access to the limited-traffic zone (ZTL) and pedestrian zone and on parking permits by resolution no. 60 of 30 November 2022; the consolidated text was published on 20 October 2025. It states that a parking permit allows parking but does not guarantee a free space, and that the permit rules apply only to disc-parking spaces allowing 90 minutes or more and to resident zones.
items.source_title: Verordnung fuer den Zugang zur verkehrsberuhigten Zone und zur Fussgaengerzone sowie Parkgenehmigungen - Gemeinde Brixen

items.text: The Dantestrasse car park was built in 1993 by Parking Brixen GmbH (later Seeste Bau GmbH) and operated for more than 30 years. When the concession contract expired, it passed to the municipality at the end of January 2025.
items.source_title: Gerichtlicher Vergleich zum Parkhaus Dantestrasse bringt Planungssicherheit - stol.it

items.text: The city and Seeste Bau settled the court case over the Dantestrasse garage concession at the Bolzano court. Seeste Bau pays a lump sum for maintenance the city had pre-financed and takes over the cost of structural securing for ten years, with works planned to keep the garage in operation as far as possible.
items.source_title: Gerichtlicher Vergleich zum Parkhaus Dantestrasse bringt Planungssicherheit - stol.it

items.text: By city executive decisions of 3 December 2025, tariffs rose from 1 January 2026. Parkhaus Brixen (Dante-Alighieri-Strasse 13) charges 2.30 EUR per hour from 07:00 to 21:00 and 1.20 EUR at night; Priel and the Mobility Centre charge 2.00 EUR per hour by day and 1.20 EUR at night; the first 30 minutes at Priel and the garage cost 1.20 EUR.
items.source_title: Gebuehrenpflichtige Parkplaetze - Erhoehung der Parktarife am 01.01.2026 - Gemeinde Brixen

items.text: Tariffs at the underground Rosslauf car park (Ignaz-Mader-Strasse) were raised from 5 December 2025 following a provincial government decision of 7 October 2025: 2.00 EUR per hour by day, 1.20 EUR at night and a 40 EUR 24-hour monthly subscription.
items.source_title: Erhoehung der Parktarife - unterirdischer Parkplatz beim Sozialwissenschaftlichen Gymnasium in der Ignaz-Mader-Strasse - Gemeinde Brixen

items.text: The municipality announced that from 1 July 2026 tariffs at metered lots would be adjusted to inflation, as most had been set in 2004. Brennerstrasse (Goldenes Roessl), Elvaser Strasse and Romstrasse are listed at 2.50 EUR per hour with a 1-hour maximum, and the stated aim is to raise turnover and point drivers to the cheaper barrier car parks and the Parkhaus.
items.source_title: Anpassung der Parktarife auf den gebuehrenpflichtigen Parkplaetzen mit Parkscheinautomaten - Gemeinde Brixen

items.text: A stol.it report of 6 May 2026 on the city council's decision on the remaining blue-zone tariffs says the tariff for the 99 spaces in the southern part of the Priel car park is to be aligned with the barrier-controlled northern part (2.00 EUR per hour by day, 1.20 EUR for the first 30 minutes and from 20:00 to 07:00), and that no subscriptions are offered there because of the lot's high utilisation. This is a qualitative remark; no occupancy figures were given.
items.source_title: Gewaltiger Preissprung: Das Parken in Brixen wird teurer - stol.it

items.text: The municipality announced that on 16 and 17 September 2026 the Parkhaus Brixen parking system would be integrated into the system of the Priel, Rosslauf and Mobility Centre car parks. Old subscription cards were announced to stop working after the switch, with new cards issued at the entrance barrier on those days.
items.source_title: Wichtige Mitteilung zur Umstellung des Parkplatzsystems - Gemeinde Brixen

items.text: The municipality manages all paid parking: four barrier-controlled facilities (Priel, Rosslauf underground, Parkhaus Brixen, Mobility Centre) and eight metered lots (including Zinggen/Eurospar, Stufels, Vintlerweg and Kreuztal). Metered lots can be paid by the EasyPark and myCicero apps; the only free lot is Fischzuchtweg, from 06:00 to 22:00.
items.source_title: P - Parkraumbewirtschaftung der Gemeinde Brixen - Gemeinde Brixen

items.text: Parkhaus Brixen at Dantestrasse 13 has five levels with 550 spaces and 44 garage boxes; height limit is 2.20 m (1.90 m on level -2). Day tickets cost 18 EUR for one day and 31 EUR for four days, and pay-on-exit is done at four automatic machines.

The Mobility Centre car park, north of the railway station in Niccolo-Castiglioni-Strasse, has 180 spaces. Park & Ride users of the Suedtirol-Pass pay a daily maximum of 6.00 EUR, reduced by 3.00 EUR per ticket validation made at the Mobility Centre; monthly subscriptions are 60 EUR (day), 80 EUR (24 h) and 50 EUR for residents without a garage.
items.source_title: P - Parkplatz Mobilitaetszentrum Brixen - Gemeinde Brixen

items.text: Priel is a barrier car park open to short-term parkers; weekly and monthly subscriptions are not available, and vehicles over 5 m in total length or with trailers may not enter. Two automatic payment machines stand directly next to the entry and exit (cash or card; amounts up to 25 EUR can be paid contactless). If UnipolMove is activated for the lot, the fee is charged through it and the barriers open automatically; EasyPark can also be used, with automatic barrier opening. Acquarena swimming pool visitors get a reduced parking fee. The page does not mention a live availability display.
items.source_title: P - Gebuehrenpflichtiger Parkplatz Priel - Gemeinde Brixen

items.text: The provincial government approved changed technical features of the Suedspange bypass on 7 August 2026 and provides 12 million EUR for the municipal section; the aim is to relieve the town centre and Milland of traffic. The route includes a roughly 72 m arch bridge over the Isarco river and better access to the future valley station of the Plose cable car.
items.source_title: Zwoelf Millionen Euro fuer Brixens Verkehrsentlastung - Suedtirol News

items.text: The Plose cable-car operator's page (read on 21 October 2026) says the valley station is 7 km from Bressanone after St. Andrae, with a large free visitor car park and bus line 321 from the town and railway station.
items.source_title: How to arrive - Plose Brixen Dolomites

items.text: The Brixen tourism page (read on 21 October 2026) tells visitors to allow extra time before events, on market days and at Christmas, and says tour buses may stop 15 minutes in Regensburger Allee and then park at Schilfweg on a 25 EUR day ticket.
